headline: On last trading session: Indian markets extended winning streak to 4 weeks as Sensex, Nifty hit 9-month highs

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying helped extend the Indian stock market rally for a fourth consecutive week.
Banking and IT stocks supported mid-day recovery during the last trading session on 20 November.
RBI Governor urged banks to step up small-business lending for greater economic gains.
CBIC proposed draft GST changes to shield genuine buyers from Input Tax Credit (ITC) loss.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to 4 weeks with overall 3% gains, reaching 9-month highs.
IndusInd Bank terminated the services of Sumant Kathpalia and invoked clawback provisions.
Markets faced early downside pressure on 20 November due to a global sell-off in AI stocks before bouncing back.
Gokul hiked buffalo milk price by ₹6 and cow milk by ₹4 per liter.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices extended their winning streak to four weeks as Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs on record FII buying. The market recovered mid-day on November 20 behind gains in banking and IT stocks despite early pressure from a global AI sell-off. Meanwhile, IndusInd Bank announced executive termination and clawback actions.
